CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION academy.e14_author_current(r academy.development_assessments)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from academy.trainer_assignments z join academy.trainer_people p on p.id=z.staff_id join academy.identities i on i.id=p.identity_id
 join academy.publication_events e on e.id=r.event_id join academy.publication_heads h on h.event_id=e.id join academy.training_dates d on d.program_id=e.program_id and d.local_date=e.day
 join academy.publication_rosters ro on ro.event_id=e.id and ro.player_id=r.player_id join academy.players pl on pl.id=ro.player_id and pl.academy_id=r.academy_id and pl.branch_id=e.branch_id
 where z.id=r.assignment_id and z.authority_revision=r.authority_revision and z.academy_id=r.academy_id and p.id=r.staff_id and i.clerk_subject=r.author and e.trainer_id=r.staff_id
 and e.published and not d.canceled and d.starts_at=e.starts_at and d.ends_at=e.ends_at and e.ends_at<=clock_timestamp()and academy.q6_eligible(r.academy_id,e.branch_id,r.staff_id))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION academy.q6_eligible(a uuid, b uuid, staff uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from academy.trainer_people p join academy.memberships m on m.id=p.membership_id and m.identity_id=p.identity_id and m.academy_id=p.academy_id
 join academy.trainer_assignments z on z.staff_id=p.id and z.academy_id=p.academy_id
 join academy.trainer_invitations v on v.id=z.invitation_id and v.staff_id=p.id and v.academy_id=p.academy_id
 where p.id=staff and p.academy_id=a and z.branch_id=b and z.state='active' and v.state='accepted' and m.role='trainer' and m.status='active')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION academy.x15_rows(a uuid, actor text, ctx jsonb, first_date date, last_date date)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, program uuid, day date, scheduled date, starts_at timestamp with time zone, ends_at timestamp with time zone, title text, branch text, sport text, sport_ar text, timezone text, state text, published boolean, capacity integer, roster_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 if actor='owner' then return query
  select coalesce(e.id,d.program_id),d.program_id,d.local_date,d.scheduled_date,d.starts_at,d.ends_at,p.definition->>'name',ctx->>'branch_name',ctx->>'sport_name',ctx->>'sport_name_ar',p.timezone,
   case when d.canceled then 'cancelled' when d.scheduled_date<>d.local_date then 'moved' when coalesce(e.published,false)then 'published' else 'draft'end,
   coalesce(e.published,false),q.capacity,coalesce(q.roster_count,0)
  from academy.training_dates d join academy.training_programs p on p.id=d.program_id and p.academy_id=a and p.state='ready' and p.branch_id=(ctx->>'branch_id')::uuid
  left join academy.date_plans q on q.program_id=d.program_id and q.local_date=d.local_date and q.academy_id=a
  left join academy.publication_heads h on h.program_id=d.program_id and h.day=d.local_date and h.academy_id=a
  left join academy.publication_events e on e.id=h.event_id and e.academy_id=a
  where d.academy_id=a and d.scheduled_date between first_date and last_date;
 elsif actor in('trainer','guardian')then return query
  select e.id,e.program_id,e.day,(e.starts_at at time zone(e.projection->>'timezone'))::date,e.starts_at,e.ends_at,e.projection->>'name',e.projection->>'branch',e.projection->>'sport',e.projection->>'sport_ar',e.projection->>'timezone',
   case when d.scheduled_date<>d.local_date then 'moved' else 'published'end,true,e.capacity,e.roster_count
  from academy.publication_heads h join academy.publication_events e on e.id=h.event_id and e.academy_id=h.academy_id
  join academy.training_dates d on d.program_id=e.program_id and d.local_date=e.day and d.academy_id=a and not d.canceled and d.starts_at=e.starts_at and d.ends_at=e.ends_at
  where h.academy_id=a and e.published and(e.starts_at at time zone(e.projection->>'timezone'))::date between first_date and last_date
  and case when actor='trainer'then e.trainer_id=(ctx->>'staff')::uuid and academy.q6_eligible(a,e.branch_id,e.trainer_id)
   else exists(select 1 from academy.publication_rosters r where r.event_id=e.id and r.player_id=(ctx->>'player')::uuid)end;
 else raise exception 'Access denied'using errcode='42501';end if;
end$function$
